facts.statement: Free Realms ran a Summer Camp community event with a different theme each week; the week described was Fashion Week.
facts.quote: Cada semana celebramos un tema diferente para entrar en el espíritu de la temporada.

article_summaries.title: Campamento de Verano – Semana de Moda (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE news post announcing Fashion Week, the themed week of the Summer Camp community event in Free Realms. It gives the weekly schedule for in-game community events and explains how players find and join them via the Game Guide calendar. It also says Trading Card Game (JCC) events run daily.
